description: Unofficial Acara fan-art animated companion inspired by the red Neopets catalogue form. Nine original states feature a horn-glint head tilt, a folded-paper bookmark display, careful paper-arch recovery and passage, quadruped movement in three directions, and a small hop. Simplified sprite rendering and paper-prop choreography are original adaptations, not official Neopets animations.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
